title: GO Command Center Signed Task V1
description: The only Execution Authority in the Control Plane. Command Center derives every parameter, signs the canonical form with the existing task-manifest signing key, and publishes it byte-identically to chenzhenxi1-sudo/go-control-tasks under tasks/<task_id>.json.

signature.description: Ed25519 over canonical(parameters+envelope) with the signature field removed.

x-go-verification-identity.note: A Task must verify ONLY against the Command Center task verifier key. It must never validate against the Hong Kong evidence verifier key. A projection that supplies the same public key for both roles must refuse every PROVEN claim.
x-go-verification-identity.related_but_distinct: Evidence is signed by the Hong Kong agent evidence signer and verified with base64. The two identities must be different keys.

x-go-notes: The agent rejects an already-seen task_id OR nonce, an already-claimed nonce, an unknown action, a mismatched authority or environment, an expired task, and any parameter set that is not exactly the frozen contract.
The agent allows exactly one executor attempt per task. A task that fails is never retried; a new task is required.
History contains Tasks whose parameter sets predate the current contract. They are preserved for lineage and must be read as LEGACY_OR_UNKNOWN, never as current proof.
The existence of a Task for an action does not mean that action is requestable. See request_v1.schema.json for the difference between known capability and enabled request action.
